text: Toronto and East York Community Council has delegated authority to appoint and remove directors from the boards of Businesses Improvement Areas (BIAs) that fall within its geographic boundaries. The purpose of this report is to recommend that Toronto and East York Community Council appoint directors to the Bloor Annex, Danforth Mosaic, The Junction, Pape Village, Toronto Downtown West, and Trinity Bellwoods BIA Boards of Management, and remove directors from the Hillcrest Village BIA Board of Management.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Appointed, in accordance with the City's Public Appointments Policy, the following nominees to the Business Improvement Area Boards of Management set out below at pleasure of Toronto and East York Community Council, and for a term expiring at the end of the term of Council or as soon thereafter as successors are appointed: Bloor Annex: Koperdraad, Ron Quintas, Daniel Robinson, Brent Sdao, Larry Venetas, Peter Danforth Mosaic: Belisle, Michelle Borch, Natalie Dertilis, Billy Ferreira, Melanie Gaudel, Krishna Jannetta, Natalee Kinde, Banchi Lee, Jacqueline Lorefice, Enza Mangano, Basil Nakhuda,Yashmeen Reilly, Mary Thompson, Jennifer The Junction: Jimaleh, Maryan Pape Village: Ameen, Jwan Mohammed Toronto Downtown West: Manuel, Michael Trinity Bellwoods: Setton, Aaron Touidjine, Halim 2.
